entities.name: Q5VS45 SDH8B
observations: The 58-aa query exactly matches reviewed Oryza sativa succinate dehydrogenase subunit 8B (100% identity and coverage; E-value 2.6e-35).
Annotated to mitochondrial inner membrane and respiratory chain complex II; associated with the tricarboxylic acid cycle.
Query sequence contains Pfam SDH8 domain PF28897.1 at residues 3–53.

observations: Reviewed rice SDH8B annotation places this protein in mitochondrial respiratory chain complex II (succinate dehydrogenase).
